answer: To resist sybils%2C each agent posts a time-locked bond of 0.1 POA that unlocks only after observing 5 independent peer tide confirmations of unique activity windows. Creating N fakes forces the attacker to lock 0.1N capital while the confirmation tide spreads coordination cost across a detection nebula%3B any cluster of simultaneous umber-aged bonds above threshold burns an extra 20% per identity.
